Hi Alex + Priya  Thanks for the productive call today. I captured the key infra/security prerequisites we need to clear before the POC can begin and sketched owners and target dates in the attached MAP. High-level target: aim to start the POC the week of Apr 11, pending these items.

Key prerequisites (summary):
- Network connectivity: VPC peering between Novaforge VPC and Redwood POC VPC, or an approved NAT/egress path if peering is not feasible. Owner: Priya (Novaforge) + Redwood infra (Aditya).
- IP allowlists: inbound and outbound CIDR blocks for control-plane endpoints and inference egress; Redwood to publish exact ranges.
- SSO/SAML: Novaforge uses Okta; we need SP metadata (XML) and one initial admin account for console access.
- Secrets & KMS: determine whether Novaforge will supply an AWS KMS CMK (preferred) or accept a Redwood-managed key; provide key ARN or confirm request.

Draft MAP milestones and owners (proposed):
1) Network handoff meeting  owner: Priya / Aditya  due: 2027-03-22
2) Redwood publishes CIDRs & port matrix  owner: Aditya  due: 2027-03-24
3) Novaforge delivers Okta SP metadata + test admin details  owner: Alex / Priya  due: 2027-03-26
4) KMS approach decided + sample IAM policy  owner: Novaforge SecOps / Aditya  due: 2027-03-29
5) MAP sign-off & confirm POC start window  owner: Marissa  target: 2027-04-07

Attachments: novaforge_map_v0.2.xlsx (MAP), redwood_peering_example.tf (hand-off template).

Can you confirm owners and whether the dates above work? Aditya is available for a 30-min network handoff on Wed/Thu mornings PST this week if either of those work for you.

Looping in a few technical specifics to make the handoff productive:

Network / peering checklist (summary):
- Required: peer between Novaforge VPC (VPC ID + account ID needed) and Redwood POC VPC. Fallback: NAT/egress via static IPs if peering cannot be arranged.
- Ports: TLS 443 for control plane, 1024-65535 ephemeral range for agent egress, and optional 9200 if you plan to send telemetry.
- CIDR sets: Redwood will publish two lists  control-plane endpoints and inference egress  to be applied to Novaforge firewall/security groups.

SSO / SAML notes:
- Okta SP metadata is the right artifact. We'll provide ACS URL and entity ID to complete the config. Manual admin account is fine for POC; SCIM is a later enhancement.

KMS / secrets handling:
- We support customer-managed AWS KMS keys. If Novaforge supplies a CMK ARN, please include an example IAM role or policy and we will validate and provide a minimal cross-account policy to attach.

Operational request: Priya, please share two 30-min windows (Wed 3/17 or Thu 3/18 mornings PT preferred) so I can book the network checklist session. I'll also publish the CIDR + port matrix by EOD today for firewall updates.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
